integrity: Proof is self-contained for the closed-half-plane characteristic exclusion. A weighted causal renewal-resolvent argument handles local exponential incidence stability under a separately stated survival exponential-moment hypothesis. Finite verification is supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The criterion is sufficient but not necessary; no claim of global stability, absence of remote periodic orbits or of a spectral gap for heavy-tailed residence durations. A complete comparison to some older full texts remains a documented originality risk.
title: A convex-survival barrier to endemic Hopf bifurcation with age-dependent infectivity
